description: Lieux de stationnement hors voirie du centre ville de Beauvais is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Beauvais. The data game on off-road parking places in the city of Beauvais is a construction of the city of Beauvais in partnership with the student teams of Sciences Po Saint-Germain-en-Laye as part of the Challenge data week organised by Datactivist and ANCT. Coverage: Ville de Beauvais. The portal shows the English title as "Off-road parking places in downtown Beauvais" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Beauvais. Its keywords include hors-voirie, parking, challenge-data, stationnement. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, PDF. The listing shows 2021-02-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
